subject: Materials Science
title: The Rule of Mixtures
description: A quick, practical guide to The Rule of Mixtures.

hook.text: Can you predict a composite's strength by knowing its ingredients? Often, yes.

buildup.text: The rule of mixtures estimates composite properties as a weighted average of each component.

discovery.text: 60% fiber at 300 GPa + 40% matrix at 3 GPa ≈ 181 GPa composite stiffness. Simple math, real power.

twist.text: It only works along the fiber direction — turn 90° and the matrix dominates, much weaker.

climax.text: Engineers use this rule to design layups — stacking fiber angles to handle multi-directional loads.

punchline.text: A composite's strength depends on direction — and design.

quiz.question: What does the rule of mixtures estimate?
options: Composite properties as a weighted average of components
How long the composite will last
